_about: Reef conservation organisations shown as 'Support reef conservation' links in the ReefSense reef panel (GET /api/reefs/{id}/support). Curated by hand: no API maps a reef to a donation page. Resolution, most specific first: site (site_id) -> region (full region label or the province before ', ') -> country (country after ', ', or the full region label) -> global. The first matching scope wins and its 1-3 organisations are shown.
_rule: Only add an organisation whose donation, support or membership page you have opened yourself: https only, HTTP 200, genuinely that organisation's own page. Never guess a URL path. Set verified_on to the day you checked. pipeline/07_check_support_links.py re-checks every URL.

coral-reef-alliance.name: Coral Reef Alliance (CORAL)
coral-reef-alliance.description: Nonprofit working with local communities to reduce direct threats to coral reefs.

reef-check.name: Reef Check Foundation
reef-check.description: Trains volunteer divers to survey reef health with a standard method, worldwide.

reef-world.name: The Reef-World Foundation
reef-world.description: Charity that coordinates Green Fins, the UN Environment Programme's sustainable diving initiative.

coral-triangle-center.name: Coral Triangle Center
coral-triangle-center.description: Indonesian foundation training marine protected area managers, with learning sites in Nusa Penida and the Banda Islands.

lini.name: Yayasan LINI (Indonesian Nature Foundation)
lini.description: Indonesian foundation building coastal communities' capacity for marine conservation.

ocean-gardener.name: Ocean Gardener
ocean-gardener.description: Bali foundation growing and replanting corals in community coral nurseries.

coral-guardian.name: Coral Guardian
coral-guardian.description: NGO restoring reefs with local communities around Hatamin island, Flores, near Komodo National Park.

kuroshio-biological-research-foundation.name: Kuroshio Biological Research Foundation
kuroshio-biological-research-foundation.description: Marine research station in Otsuki, Kochi, studying corals and sea life of the Kuroshio current.

kuroshio-jikkan-center.name: Kuroshio Jikkan Center (黒潮実感センター)
kuroshio-jikkan-center.description: NPO on Kashiwajima island caring for its sea with residents and running nature education.

team-chura-sango.name: Team Chura Sango (チーム美らサンゴ)
team-chura-sango.description: Partnership of companies running coral planting and awareness programmes in Onna, Okinawa.

sango-hozen-kyokai.name: Coral Conservation Association (サンゴ保全協会)
sango-hozen-kyokai.description: Okinawa association planting corals and running marine conservation activities in Onna.

wwf-japan.name: WWF Japan
wwf-japan.description: WWF's Japan office; its coral reef work includes Shiraho on Ishigaki and Amami Oshima.

reef-check-malaysia.name: Reef Check Malaysia
reef-check-malaysia.description: Malaysian nonprofit surveying reefs and supporting community-led marine conservation.

wwf-malaysia.name: WWF-Malaysia
wwf-malaysia.description: Coral restoration and monitoring in Tun Mustapha Park, Malaysia's largest multi-use marine park.

marine-conservation-philippines.name: Marine Conservation Philippines
marine-conservation-philippines.description: Nonprofit in Zamboanguita, Negros Oriental, surveying and protecting coastal reefs.

save-philippine-seas.name: Save Philippine Seas
save-philippine-seas.description: Filipino nonprofit mobilising communities and young people for marine conservation.

marine-conservation-cambodia.name: Marine Conservation Cambodia
marine-conservation-cambodia.description: Nonprofit protecting Cambodia's marine ecosystems with the Fisheries Administration and fishers.

song-saa-foundation.name: Song Saa Foundation
song-saa-foundation.description: Nonprofit protecting the marine habitats and supporting the communities of the Koh Rong Archipelago.

fauna-flora-cambodia.name: Fauna & Flora (Cambodia marine programme)
fauna-flora-cambodia.description: Supports community fisheries and Cambodia's marine protected areas.

new-heaven-reef-conservation.name: New Heaven Reef Conservation Program
new-heaven-reef-conservation.description: Restores and monitors the coral reefs around Koh Tao with coral nurseries and artificial reefs.

wwf-hong-kong.name: WWF-Hong Kong
wwf-hong-kong.description: WWF's Hong Kong office; runs a coral restoration initiative with the Chinese University of Hong Kong.
